skills.name: Parse visible Sokoban entities and player-relative relations
Assess a visible box push before acting
Reach the required side of a box
Select a bounded Sokoban action batch
Verify parsed actions and visible state change
Replan after an unchanged or non-progressing state

contexts.description: The current response requires visually grounded player-relative statements about visible boxes or targets.
A directional choice could push a neighboring visible box, requiring inspection of the player side, destination, and nearby blockers.
A contemplated box movement requires the player to first navigate to a different visible side of the box.
The current board supports a short sequence of immediate walking movements within one response without an intervening uncertain push.
The next movement could push a box or encounter a visible obstruction, favoring a minimal batch and earlier observation check.
A selected action must be placed in the native structured response rather than emitted as unconstrained text.
A prior response produced no parsed action in association with format-related feedback, so the next response requires renewed serialization compliance.
A prior action submission has later feedback or a board observation that can establish the actual visible outcome before another decision.
The displayed board repeats a recent visible arrangement after an attempted action or empty action extraction.
